_meta.purpose: Extraction eval set for M7 memory — 30 transcripts scored as remember_fact fire-rate (SDS 14.7, O2, 7.6).
_meta.measures: given the shipped tool schemas + 7.6 capability instructions, does the model call remember_fact exactly when it should?
_meta.voice: transcripts are single user utterances in the user's own voice — the thing the model hears, NOT a database row.
_meta.scoring: an item hits if the model's remember_fact firing matches expect_fire. Tracked over time, never gates CI; needs a live key.

categories.positive: a durable fact the user was told — remember_fact MUST fire (expect_kind names the expected kind)
categories.negative-remark: a passing remark / small talk — must NOT fire (7.6: 'do not store passing remarks')
categories.negative-question: the user is asking, not telling — must NOT fire (7.6: '...or questions')
categories.negative-inferred: something the model could infer but was NOT told — must NOT fire (7.6's load-bearing clause)
